ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (v0.39.2)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description:
DEUTSCH — Aragorn – Armee der Toten
Rette Aragorn, schmiede Andúril neu und befreie 13 Geisterkrieger in einer zusammenhängenden Questreihe. Beschwöre eine Geisterarmee mit sechs Klassen, nutze den Königlichen Befehl, mächtige Blitze, Andúrils Rundumschlag und Aragorns EMP-Sturm. Gegnerstärke, Geisterrüstung und Fähigkeiten sind einstellbar.
ENGLISH — Aragorn – Army of the Dead
Rescue Aragorn, reforge Andúril, and release 13 spectral warriors in a connected quest campaign. Summon an army across six classes and wield the King's Command, devastating lightning strikes, Andúril's sweeping attack, and Aragorn's EMP Storm. Adjust quest difficulty, spirit armor, and abilities in the mod settings.
v0.39.2 | RimWorld 1.6 | HOTFIX: resolves empty quest maps after terrain/roof exceptions. Rescue-map construction now logs stages, generates a basic but usable two-ring emergency prison if the deep-water fortress builder fails, and automatically retries unfinished rescue encounters on already-generated maps instead of leaving a permanent empty clearing. An existing captive Aragorn is reused. The Anduril forge likewise recovers missing workbenches or smiths on existing sites, clears its mountain-obstructed construction footprint, validates the workstation and retries unfinished construction automatically. Existing rescue and forge quest state, six ghost classes, 13 indestructible sarcophagi, Profaned danger scaling, saved Gizmos and all graphics remain unchanged.
